'''Wyrd''' is an independent system in the Core Systems, home to '''[[Black Hide]]''', the workshop of '''[[The Dweller]]'''. The Dweller is one of the independent starting Engineers, requiring no referral from another Engineer.<ref name="inara-wyrd">[https://inara.cz/elite/starsystem/236/ Wyrd — Star System], Inara.</ref>

== Overview ==

* '''Star:''' Class K (scoopable)
* '''Allegiance:''' Independent
* '''Government:''' Corporate
* '''Security:''' Medium
* '''Economy:''' Extraction / Agriculture<ref name="inara-wyrd" />

== Engineer Facility ==

'''[[Black Hide]]''' is a surface Engineer base on Wyrd A 2, operated by '''[[The Dweller]]'''.<ref name="inara-black-hide">[https://inara.cz/elite/station/52127/ Black Hide in Wyrd — Station], Inara.</ref>

No system permit is required to enter Wyrd. See [[The Dweller]] for the full discovery, invitation, and unlock requirements for his workshop.
